statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The denial reason code is CO-22
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities
The service is required to determine whether an intermittent arrhythmia explains the transient cerebral ischemic events
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia as a potential etiology for transient cerebral ischemic events
